story.twist: Their mother asks the narrator why she stopped giving birthday gifts, revealing that the brother has accepted sole credit for years.

youtube.description: Years of bank transfers changed one family's idea of who had been buying the presents.
youtube.title: My Brother Took Credit for Every Family Gift
